title: AdaptHealth Corp. To Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
body_markdown:
CONSHOHOCKEN, Pa. – May 5, 2026 - AdaptHealth Corp. (NASDAQ: AHCO) (“AdaptHealth” or the “Company”), a national leader in providing patient-centered, healthcare-at-home solutions including home medical equipment, medical supplies, and related services, announced today that they will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


**The Bank of America Global Healthcare Conference,** being held in Las Vegas, on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, including a fireside chat at 9:20 a.m. PT.


Webcast Link:[https://bofa.veracast.com/webcasts/bofa/healthcare2026/H2Q04E.cfm](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbofa.veracast.com%2Fwebcasts%2Fbofa%2Fhealthcare2026%2FH2Q04E.cfm&data=05%7C02%7Cchriscamera%40adapthealth.com%7Cf4b1e8a60ab34e234eb708deaac6d4bd%7C1ddbb8f217904f35ab5554465ce0a9cc%7C0%7C0%7C639135968249769115%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=dEuenwgEPpxY13Sxysutanb9nGS7KwVFfVa%2F7ej5%2BDg%3D&reserved=0)


**The RBC Global Healthcare Conference** , being held in New York, on Tuesday, May 19, 2026, including a fireside chat at 3:05 p.m. ET.
